description: This file defines the interface RetrieveFeaturesLiveCommand, which extends other command interfaces, and serves as a live command for retrieving features in the context of the Eclipse Ditto project. It provides access to command specifics and serves as an entry point for creating answer builders.

classes.name: RetrieveFeaturesLiveCommand
classes.description: An interface representing a live command to retrieve features, extending LiveCommand and ThingQueryCommand, providing accessors and response creation capabilities.
